newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end of record, Ericsson strong.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end of record, Ericsson strong.

text.p: Swedish shares ended at a record high on Friday for the fourth consecutive day, boosted by strong international trends.
The exchange's general index rose 0.90 percent to 2,773.23 in active turnover of 5.03 billion crowns.
"The initital downturn after U.S. statistics was followed by very strong bourse trends all over Europe," a dealer said.
Telecoms group Ericsson leaped 10.5 crowns to 270.5 crowns on general market strength.
"Ericsson is the most important share in Sweden and is on all large firms' buying lists," a trader said.
Metals and mining group Trelleborg jumped seven crowns to 128 in heavy trading.
"There was a sharp upturn late in the afternoon (in Trelleborg) and this will continue on Monday," a trader said. "The buying side was not exhausted."
Drugs major Astra ended flat at 370 crowns after pharmaceutical shares slipped in the U.S. a day earlier.
Forestry shares were mixed with AssiDoman dropping seven crowns to 203 and MoDo edging one lower to 250.5 crowns.
